mapper.select:
SELECT 'HOTEL' AS booking_type, b.id AS hotel_booking_id, NULL::uuid AS activity_order_id, b.organization_id, org.owner_user_id, b.user_id AS guest_user_id, b.booking_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(b.guest_lead ->> 'fullName', ''), NULLIF(b.guest_lead ->> 'name', ''), NULLIF(b.guest_lead ->> 'firstName', ''), u.full_name) AS guest_name, p.title AS property_name, b.check_in_date, b.check_out_date, NULL::timestamp AS slot_starts_at, b.booking_status AS status FROM hotel_bookings b JOIN host_organizations org ON org.id = b.organization_id JOIN hotel_profiles h ON h.id = b.hotel_id LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id = h.place_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND b.user_id IS NOT NULL AND org.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND b.booking_status IN
AND ((b.check_in_date + COALESCE(h.check_in_time, TIME '14:00')) - (#{offsetHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) BETWEEN ( - (#{lookbackHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) AND
AND ((b.check_out_date + COALESCE(h.check_out_time, TIME '12:00')) + (#{offsetHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) BETWEEN ( - (#{lookbackHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) AND
AND (COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(v.created_at) FROM marketplace_entity_versions v WHERE v.entity_type = 'HOTEL_BOOKING' AND v.entity_id = b.id AND v.snapshot ->> 'bookingStatus' = 'CONFIRMED'), b.updated_at) + (#{offsetHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) BETWEEN (CAST(#{now} AS TIMESTAMP) - (#{lookbackHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) AND CAST(#{now} AS TIMESTAMP)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_scheduled_message_runs run WHERE run.scheduled_message_id = #{scheduledMessageId} AND run.hotel_booking_id = b.id) ORDER BY b.created_at, b.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'ACTIVITY' AS booking_type, NULL::uuid AS hotel_booking_id, o.id AS activity_order_id, o.organization_id, org.owner_user_id, o.user_id AS guest_user_id, o.order_code AS booking_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(o.contact_info ->> 'fullName', ''), NULLIF(o.contact_info ->> 'name', ''), u.full_name) AS guest_name, a.title AS property_name, NULL::date AS check_in_date, NULL::date AS check_out_date, s.starts_at AS slot_starts_at, o.order_status AS status FROM activity_orders o JOIN host_organizations org ON org.id = o.organization_id JOIN activity_bookings a ON a.id = o.activity_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_slots s ON s.id = o.slot_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.user_id IS NOT NULL AND org.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND o.order_status IN
AND s.starts_at IS NOT NULL AND (s.starts_at - (#{offsetHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) BETWEEN ( - (#{lookbackHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) AND
AND (COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(v.created_at) FROM marketplace_entity_versions v WHERE v.entity_type = 'ACTIVITY_ORDER' AND v.entity_id = o.id AND v.snapshot ->> 'orderStatus' = 'CONFIRMED'), o.updated_at) + (#{offsetHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) BETWEEN (CAST(#{now} AS TIMESTAMP) - (#{lookbackHours} * INTERVAL '1 hour')) AND CAST(#{now} AS TIMESTAMP)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_scheduled_message_runs run WHERE run.scheduled_message_id = #{scheduledMessageId} AND run.activity_order_id = o.id) ORDER BY o.created_at, o.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT booking_status FROM hotel_bookings WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT order_status FROM activity_orders WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketplace_scheduled_message_runs SET status = #{status}, detail = #{detail}, conversation_id = COALESCE(#{conversationId}, conversation_id), message_id = COALESCE(#{messageId}, message_id) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT run.*, COALESCE(hb.booking_code, ao.order_code) AS booking_code FROM marketplace_scheduled_message_runs run LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id = run.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id = run.activity_order_id WHERE run.scheduled_message_id = #{scheduledMessageId} ORDER BY run.sent_at DESC, run.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
